prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:138425 `the value of the sequencer screens' "TIME SIG.=" field` -- Seq_LoadTimeSigAtCurrentMeasure header: (0x0DE3) is the TIME SIG. field and (0x6034D7) the song's own beats per bar
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:120524 `ld	(TransportA_BeatsPerBar:24), a` -- ... and writes the same cells by hand (0xC3 at 120525, 0x0DE3 at 120534)

header:
WA = a block number: reads its next link (+3); 0xFFFF -> nothing to do; > BStore_BlockLimit -> BStore_ErrorCode 10; else BStore_FreeChain (via T_F42888) from that next block,
which re-links the predecessor to the chain's end. Every caller first runs BStore_SaveCursor, which leaves WA = (0x0C57), the cursor block. Basis: callers + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:142168 `calr	BStore_SeekBlock` -- seek block HL = WA
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:142170 `ld	wa, (xhl+3)` -- the NEXT link (block layout, FINDINGS-prom_b-block-store.md: +3..+4 next)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:142172 `cp	wa, 65535` -- end of chain: return
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:142179 `ld	iy, wa` -- IY = first block to free
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:186535 `calr	BStore_FreeChain` -- ... -> BStore_FreeChain (IY = first block of the chain)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:186764 `ld	(xhl+3), iy` -- BStore_FreeChain re-links the freed run's predecessor to what followed it
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:142669 `ld	wa, (3159:16)` -- BStore_SaveCursor's last WA load: WA = (0x0C57), the block number (its header, 142627)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:143853 `calr	sub_F63510` -- sub_F6418E: same pair (SaveCursor at 143852)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:134814 `call	T_F42794` -- sub_F5E570 via thunk T_F42794, right after `call T_BStore_SaveCursor` (134813); 7 more thunk sites have the same pair
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:141261 `calr	sub_F63510` -- NOTE: the 'BStore_LoadGeometry_Call' caller in the batch is an unlabelled calr/ret wrapper after that label, not a real caller

header:

class (0x11AE), (0x11AF)&0x7F, (0x11B0)&0x7F; stops when (0x1238) flags a store failure. The volume / effect-depth CC handlers set class 3/5/6/7 first. Basis: callers + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:170960 `calr	Smf_TicksToPpq96` -- byte 2: delta from the word array 0x10D3[ch] (170955)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:170968 `ld	xix, ByteMap_F70298` -- byte 3: the channel (ByteMap_F70298 is the identity 0..15, 169156)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:169730 `ld	(4526:16), 3` -- SmfCC_Volume: class 3, value = CC data (0x10D2) ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:170461 `stores it in the track as a 0xB0 parameter event of class` -- sibling sub_F70B22 (RPN values) writes the same event shape

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:73631 `string-table readout` -- DL_F34D98: op 02 records reading DisplayListB_Stage+n

header:
`jp sub_F678C6`, which steps A by the soft key: upper switch (W bit 7 clear) A+1 capped at H, lower switch (W bit 7 set) A-1 floored at L (signed).
StepRecordSub00's soft keys 4/5/6 step (0x12AC) 1..13, (0x12AD) 0..12, (0x12AE) 0..3 through it; sub_F678C6 can take the name without the suffix. Basis: callers + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:148653 `bit	7, w` -- sub_F678C6: which switch of the column
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:148658 `ld	a, h` -- ... capped at H
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:148662 `cp	a, l` -- ... floored at L (jr GE, signed)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:148607 `bit 7 of the code picks the LOWER (set) or UPPER (clear)` -- SoftKeyCol4_StepRecordSub00 header: what W bit 7 is
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:148610 `ld	a, (4780:16)` -- SoftKeyCol4: A = (0x12AC), L = 1, H = 13 ...

why_refused: The body is only `ld B,0xFF / ret`; its callers compare B with 0xFF, 22 and 23 but nothing says what B stands for, so no name beyond the constant is supported (finding: the 22/23 arms in StepRecordSub17_SoftKeyCol6/7 and the `jr nz` at 0xF68F7B are never taken).
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:151881 `cp	b, 255` -- StepRecordSub00_LcdKeyRow4: `jr nz` after it can never branch
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:156642 `cp	b, 22` -- StepRecordSub17_SoftKeyCol7: never equal (also cp b,23 at 156644)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:156686 `cp	b, 22` -- StepRecordSub17_SoftKeyCol6: the same dead test

show its name. 1 stop: release the drive, clear b2. Callers use it where INT and FD MIDI FILE use T_Medley_Start / _Stop / _Next. Basis: callers + body.

prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:163648 `m_or_mi8 MBI+r4, 0, 0x04` -- case 0: (0x34D0) bit 2, the medley-running bit Medley_StartMidiFile / _LoadInternalSong also set

prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:146368 `for an INT source, or FD with a NORM file: T_Medley_Stop` -- CONFLICT: this caller header says NORM where the code (cp (0x0e35),0x01) and Medley_Stop's header (prom_a 175995, FD + MIDI FILE) say MIDI FILE

header:
Copies 11 bytes of MIDI-file listing entry n (arg) at 0x60A480 + 8*n to Disk_FileName -- the 8-byte stride of the MIDI-file listing, not the 16-byte disk directory.

header:
Waits for CPU 2's reply mark (Drawbar_WaitReloadMark); when it is 1 requests screen 0xA3, DRAWBAR (UI_Request = 0x80A3).
SOUND MODE runs it on install (unless it came back from 0xA3) and on LcdKeyRow1's lower switch. Basis: callers + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:115831 `m_set 7, MD16, UI_Request_Hi` -- ... sets the go-to-screen byte 0x80 ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:115847 `Callers branch on 1 (DRAWBAR, screen 0xA3)` -- Drawbar_WaitReloadMark header
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:32597 `m_cp_mi8 MB16, UI_ScreenId_Previous, 0xa3` -- InstallPainter_SoundMode skips it when returning from DRAWBAR ...
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:33286 `call T_F42E68` -- LcdKeyRow1_SoundMode, W bit 7 set

header:
Playing-track mask (0x60341E) := (0x360C), its saved copy, then T_NoteRouting_RebuildForSong. The ENTER of panel modes SEQ PLAY and REALTIME RECORD;
twin sub_F57443 (Seq_SavePlayingTrackMask, batch f) copies it back on the mode LEAVEs. Basis: callers + body + twin.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:123654 `call	T_NoteRouting_RebuildForSong` -- routes rebuilt for it
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:123670 `ld	(13836:16), xwa` -- twin sub_F57443: the reverse copy
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:121791 `; Calls:   sub_F57443` -- ModeLeave_SeqPlay uses the twin

header:
Paints the four ordinal rows of the LFO page on layer 0: slot n's bit 2n-2 of (0x27A4) set -> the text record '1st'..'4th' (DLRecordPtrs_F3281C), clear -> bitmap form (Data_F32864 lists of Data_F0191A).
Four-row form of UiPaint_Ordinals; called by the LFO page painter and SoundEditLfo_RepaintField's whole-page case. Basis: callers + body + sibling.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:131427 `ld	xiz, DLRecordPtrs_F3281C` -- bit set: op-20 text records ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:131416 `ld	xiz, Data_F32864` -- bit clear: bitmap records (F32834.. draw Data_F0191A + k*0x1E, 68519-68535)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:130158 `UiPaint_Ordinals:` -- the sibling with the same bit test

header:
Erases (op 1B) the box (0xDD,0x44)-(0xED,0xCB), then draws a line from the LF0n row given by page field 0 (rows y 0x44/0x64/0x82/0xA2; 0 counts as 1) right to x 0xED and down to y 0xCB, above the TOUCH caption.
Called by the LFO page painter and by SoundEditLfo_RepaintField for field 0 and the whole page. Basis: callers + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:132421 `ld	xix, DL_F054F7` -- DL_F054ED: op 1B, the erase-rectangle service (notes/FINDINGS-prom_b-graphics-veneers.md:30), (0xDD,0x44)-(0xED,0xCB) (14085-14089)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:132423 `ld	c, (ModelingPage_Fields:16)` -- field 0 of the page
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:14123 `0x11, 0x0A, 0xDE, 0x00, 0x44, 0x00, 0xED, 0x00, 0x44, 0x00, 0x12, 0x0A` -- each list: op 11 (0xDE,y)-(0xED,y), op 12 (0xED,y)-(0xED,0xCB); y = 0x44, 0x64, 0x82, 0xA2
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:16124 `.ascii "LF01"` -- row labels LF01..LF04 (16130, 16136, 16142) at y 64/96/126/158, beside the line starts
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:16166 `.short 0x00EA` -- the TOUCH caption (16168) sits at x 0xEA, y 0xD0: the line ends just above it; what field 0 means is not established
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:132367 `call	sub_F5CFA4` -- SoundEditLfo_RepaintField, code 0 (the field it reads)

header:
For fields 12..15 of the TONE LAYER PANNING page (layers 1..4's pan amount) runs record [n] of Data_F32992+0x28 -- a decimal readout of ModelingPage_Fields+n -- skipping zero amounts (centre).
prom_a's ToneLayerPan_SplitSideAndAmount (sub_FD7D18) writes these fields. Called by the page's Paint and RepaintField. Basis: callers + body + writer.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:132950 `jr	z, sub_F5D4A7_Return` -- ... zero -> nothing drawn
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:132953 `call	RunDisplayListBFromPointerArray` -- record [n] of the array at Data_F32992+0x28
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:68705 `0x00, 0x0A, 0xB2, 0x27` -- F32992: B op 00 (decimal readout) of 0x27B2 = field 12; the next three read 0x27B3..0x27B5
prom_a/wsa1_prom_a.s:145026 `add E,0x0b` -- sub_FD7D18 ((0x27F5) == 0): amount of layer L goes to field L+0x0B, i.e. 12..15

why_refused: It walks the stream counting 0x81 tags up to (0x0D1C), (0x0C77) times, calling the unnamed sub_F63749 at each stop, and its only callers are unnamed sequencer-edit routines, so what the count and the call mean is not established.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:142213 `mx_cp_mi8 MXB, ra_HL, ra_IY, 0x81` -- ... 0x81 tags (0x82 is error 7, 142210)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:142228 `calr	sub_F63749` -- the unnamed step at each stop
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:141263 `calr	sub_F6353E` -- the batch's 'BStore_LoadGeometry_Call' caller is only an unlabelled calr/ret wrapper
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:135735 `call	T_F42798` -- real callers: sub_F5E570, sub_F5EE9A, sub_F5F02C ... all sub_

why_refused: Three calls of the unnamed T_F4270C and a test of the byte at the cursor (L = 1 when it is > 0); both callers are unnamed BStore-module routines, so nothing establishes what it decides.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:143445 `call	T_F4270C` -- unnamed step, three times

why_refused: Save position slot 0, unnamed sub_F6B75E, restore slot 0, then unnamed sub_F6B657 with W = (0x0ECE) (a block-length adjust through T_F427E8); without those two the action cannot be named from its callers.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:152548 `calr	sub_F6C292` -- save slot 0 (StepRecord_SaveCursorToSlot in this batch)

header:
Sets the entry's saved end cursor (0x60347E word / 0x6034A0 byte, the pair BStore_SaveCursor writes) to the byte after its song position (0x3460/0x3482; past 0xFF -> next block, offset 5),
then frees every block after that one (sub_F6BAFA, a copy of BStore_FreeChain). Step-record callers run it right after writing a 0x82 / 0x84 terminator there. Basis: callers + body.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:156751 `mx_ld_rm MXW, ra_IX, ra_IZ, 5` -- the position's block 0x3460[n]; 0xFFFF -> return (156753)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:156761 `mx_ld_rm MXB, ra_IX, ra_IZ, 1` -- its offset 0x3482[n] ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:156769 `mx_ld_mi8 MXD, ra_IX, ra_IZ, 0x05` -- past the block: offset 5 of the next block (156776-156779)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:156795 `mx_st_mr8 MXD, ra_IX, ra_IZ, 1` -- end offset -> 0x6034A0[n] ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:156800 `mx_st_mr16 MXD, ra_IX, ra_IZ, 5` -- ... end block -> 0x60347E[n]
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:156790 `calr	sub_F6BAFA` -- free from the block after it (WA = BStore_BlockCount)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:158182 `ld	bc, (BStore_FreeHead:24)` -- sub_F6BAFA: BStore_FreeChain's instructions (186723-186747) byte for byte
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:142629 `writes the offset byte to 0x006034A0[n-1] and the block-number` -- BStore_SaveCursor header: the same saved-cursor pair
notes/FINDINGS-prom_b-block-store.md:151 `saved cursor must be pointing at` -- 0x82 / 0x84 terminate
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:156656 `ld	w, 130:opc` -- StepRecordSub17_SoftKeyCol7 writes 0x82 at position + 1 ...
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:156724 `calr	sub_F6B134` -- StepRecordSub17_SoftKeyCol6, after writing 0x84 at position + 1 (156720-156721)

header:
Stores W at the current entry's song position: block 0x3460[n], offset 0x3482[n], n = BStore_DirEntry - 1. Write twin of BStore_ReadByteAtSongPosition;
the step-record handlers write the 0x81 / 0x82 / 0x84 stream tags with it. Basis: callers + body + read twin.
evidence: prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:158057 `mx_ld_rm MXW, ra_DE, ra_IZ, 5` -- offset 0x3482[n] (low byte, 158060)
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:158062 `mx_st_mr8 MXD, ra_HL, ra_IY, 0` -- (block + offset) := W
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:157831 `mx_ld_rm MXB, ra_HL, ra_IY, 1` -- BStore_ReadByteAtSongPosition: the same address, read
prom_b/wsa1_prom_b.s:156653 `calr	sub_F6B9DF` -- ... written; then 0x82 at the next position (156656-156657)
